prompt_construction.structure: single user message = verbatim task prompt; for the three capability benchmarks the task template itself carries the answer-format instruction; nothing else is appended

reasoning_channel_policy.answer_source: FINAL channel only (content after the native reasoning delimiter or the parser's 'content' field)
reasoning_channel_policy.reasoning_text: stored in full; never scored; a correct-looking answer inside reasoning with no final answer is NOT credited
reasoning_channel_policy.no_final: NO_FINAL_ANSWER (scored 0) when generation ends naturally without a final channel

primary_status_precedence: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE (transport/backend crash/stall; provider finish reasons insufficient_system_resource, aborted, network_error, model_context_window_exceeded, or a missing finish reason; attempt missing, rerun policy applies)
PROVIDER_FILTERED (v2: provider moderation finish reasons content_filter / sensitive; rerun policy applies; if persistent the attempt is MISSING and counted separately)
MALFORMED_NATIVE_OUTPUT (native parser rejects a naturally-stopped output, e.g. missing EOS/</think>, unexpected special tokens, tool call in a no-tools study)
BUDGET_TRUNCATED (output ceiling reached before a complete final channel)
NO_FINAL_ANSWER (natural stop, empty or absent final channel)
EXTRACTION_FAILURE (final channel present, scorer cannot extract an answer)
overlapping_flags: provider_repetition_truncation (v2: Xiaomi finish_reason repetition_truncation; primary status NO_FINAL_ANSWER; a provider intervention, reported per route)
model_echo_changed (v2: echoed model id differs from the first attempt of that route; triggers the drift abort)
attempt_status.scoring: every status except INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE scores 0 for accuracy and counts in the denominator

retries.semantic_retries: none - a wrong, truncated, looping or unparseable answer is final
retries.infrastructure_reruns: up to 2 reruns of the same item with identical rendered prompt, settings and seed; if still failing the attempt is MISSING
retries.operational_watchdog: abort a request with no new token for 30 minutes or 48 hours total -> INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE (stall); these limits are operational, not capability budgets, and wall-clock speed never affects scores

budget_policy.design: one common ceiling C on GENERATED tokens (reasoning + final) for all six configurations; matched-token sensitivity analyses derived post hoc from the same generations
budget_policy.v1_rule_superseded: v1: C = T = min(native context - max prompt - 1024) (planning ~245,760). Not achievable under hosted execution; retained in the archived v1 file.
budget_policy.terminal_ceiling_rule_v2: C_max = min over the six EXECUTION ROUTES of the documented maximum number of GENERATED tokens per request (reasoning included), and <= native context - max rendered prompt - 1024 for every model. Context windows are NOT output limits.

P25-deepseek.status: verified-doc ('1 to 384K'); default 128K at max effort; reasoning inclusion confirmed at T2

P28-zai / P27-zai.status: verified-doc as a max_tokens limit; whether it includes reasoning is UNDOCUMENTED (T2)

P34-dedicated-fp8.status: engine setting (native context minus prompt); includes every generated token

c_max_value.status: pending: holds only if integration test T2 shows Z.ai max_tokens bounds reasoning+final tokens and T1 shows every route accepts 131072. If Z.ai max_tokens excludes reasoning, the common ceiling cannot be enforced server-side on P27/P28 and the protocol requires a pre-outcome decision (client-side stream cut-off at C counted from usage, or a different GLM route).
c_max_value.prompt_headroom: longest final/dev prompt = 25,558 characters (<= ~12K tokens at 2.2 chars/token); P34 native 262,144 - 12,000 - 1,024 >> 131,072, so no tokenizer is needed to establish feasibility

development_calibration.purpose: measure the generated-token distribution and censoring on disjoint development items at C_dev before any final generation; verify plumbing and stop semantics
development_calibration.run_ceiling: C_dev = C_max (131072, pending) for every configuration
development_calibration.adequacy_criterion: for each configuration, BUDGET_TRUNCATED at C_dev <= 5% of development attempts (excluding INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE), with the 95% Wilson upper bound reported
development_calibration.if_criterion_fails: proceed at C_final anyway (no model-specific ceiling); flag the configuration 'budget-censored at the maximum valid common ceiling' in every table.

ceiling_selection_rule.floor_reason: 65,536 is the largest post-hoc sensitivity ceiling; C_final below it would make that analysis impossible
ceiling_selection_rule.definition: for configuration m and candidate L: D_m(L) = number of development attempts that ended NATURALLY (finish 'stop') within C_dev but generated more than L tokens (= attempts that a ceiling L would additionally censor). Attempts already truncated at C_dev (including loops) are censored at every L and are not counted in D_m(L).
ceiling_selection_rule.rule: C_final = the smallest L in the ladder such that, for EVERY configuration, D_m(L) <= 2 overall (<= 0.9% of 216; 95% Wilson upper bound 3.3%) AND D_m(L) <= 1 within each benchmark. If no smaller L qualifies, C_final = C_dev.
ceiling_selection_rule.freeze: C_final, the per-model D_m(L) table, the development summary and its sha256 are written into this file and calibrated=true is set BEFORE any final request; the runner refuses final generation otherwise
ceiling_selection_rule.what_may_not_influence_C: development ACCURACY, cost, runtime or any single model's preference; only the pre-registered censoring counts above

measurements_reported: per-model and per-benchmark distribution of generated tokens (median, p90, p95, p99, max)
BUDGET_TRUNCATED count at C_dev with Wilson bounds
token-count agreement: usage.completion_tokens vs reasoning_tokens where both exist
development_calibration.no_answer_tuning: development accuracy is recorded but may not change prompts, settings, models or C

post_hoc_matched_token_sensitivity.method: an attempt counts as completed at ceiling c only if its total generated tokens <= c; otherwise BUDGET_TRUNCATED at c. Valid because a lower cap does not change earlier tokens of the same generation; requires per-attempt token counts. Labelled sensitivity analysis, never the primary result.
post_hoc_matched_token_sensitivity.caveat: equal token caps are not equal compute across architectures/tokenizers

optional_secondary_condition.name: publisher-recommended output length
optional_secondary_condition.applies_to: configurations whose native context supports it without extension (not P34)
optional_secondary_condition.status: not part of this protocol's required work; may be added only by a pre-result amendment

generations_and_seeds.rationale: more distinct items beats repeated generations for estimating item-population accuracy; repeats would be clustered by item
generations_and_seeds.no_best_of: no pass@k, no majority vote, no selection among samples

statistical_plan.per_benchmark_estimate: accuracy with 95% Wilson interval, per configuration
statistical_plan.pairwise: 15 model pairs x 3 capability benchmarks = 45 paired comparisons; exact McNemar test on item-level correct/incorrect (missing items dropped pairwise, count reported); Holm correction across the 45; paired difference with 95% paired-bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of items, seed 20260929)
statistical_plan.no_composite: no single intelligence score; an unweighted mean across the three benchmarks may be shown only as a labelled descriptive summary
statistical_plan.missing_data: primary analysis complete-case; sensitivity analysis scores MISSING as incorrect
statistical_plan.precision_statement: with n=400-460 per benchmark, a single accuracy has a 95% interval of roughly +/-4.5 percentage points near 50%; differences smaller than this are not claimed
statistical_plan.contamination: public benchmarks may be in training data; disjoint dev/final splits do not remove this; no decontamination claim
